content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Add or Remove Virtual Terminal Fields ## slug: vt-add-remove-virtual-terminal-fields ## seoTitle: Add or Remove Virtual Terminal Fields ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Adding, removing, and modifying fields on the Virtual Terminal is done through [Field Sets](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.fields_about_field_sets.htm&type=5){target="_blank"}. A Field Set is a grouping of fields that can be displayed on Lightning Components. A user can then add, remove, or rearrange fields from the Field Set, without altering the Lightning Component. :::(Info) (Limitation) Formula and auto-number fields cannot be added to the field set. :::
